result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues where content is cut off at the viewport edges, preventing users from viewing complete information about restaurants and menu items.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally clipped and not fully visible. The name also appears truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel layout to either show cards fully within the viewport or ensure proper spacing/padding so that partially visible cards remain readable and complete

issues.description: A restaurant card below the Tokumaru Ramen Bar in 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off, showing only a partial pizza image with a discount label visible at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing and card height or implement proper scrolling behavior to ensure all cards are fully visible or clearly indicate there is more content below
